events.title: Demo released!
events.summary: The demo is out! If you have 15 minutes and need to scratch a strategy itch, give it a try - it's 100MB download only and after 3 minutes tutorial, you can dive directly into one of the four MISSIONS with increasing difficulty. If you have more time (about an hour), the OPERATION is great too!I'll keep developing the game and updating both playtest and the demo, so your feedback is important more than ever now.

events.title: Demo release planned for August 28th
events.summary: Playtest runs for more than a month now and I did not get many issue reports, so it seems to be working just fine. I decided to take another step on the journey and I plan to release demo on August 28th.What doest it mean for you?Official demo will be available with one operation and a few predefined missions.Playtest will become closed again.You will not have access to Custom Missions as they will be part of the full release.If you want to keep playtesting, let me know and I'll consider issuing
